message.reasoning_content: We need to determine appropriate crimes based on facts. The case: defendant卫某某 bought prohibited cultural relics (copper artifacts) from Li, intending to resell for profit. He then deceived victim俞某某 by promising high profit from buying and selling artifacts, got 5 million RMB, used it for personal purposes, later gave back 1 million and gave low-value artifacts as compensation.
